title: Brian
creator: CrossFit
description: Three rounds of 5 rope climbs to 15 ft and 25 back squats at 185/125 lb. Honours U.S. Navy SEAL Chief Petty Officer Brian R. Bill, killed in the 2011 Chinook shoot-down in Wardak Province, Afghanistan. Only two movements; the squats will feel heavier than they look after the climbs.
